verdict.rationale: Terraform documents versioning: configurations are human-readable files you can version, and HCP Terraform adds version control integration. It also documents review: `terraform plan` previews changes, speculative plans can be checked before code review, saved plan files are applied as reviewed, and `show -json` makes plans machine-readable. However, no first-party rollback capability appears in the evidence; community reports rely on manual state backups and S3 object versioning, and note that apply is not a transactional boundary. Missing for 10: native rollback of applied changes or state, documented revert workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of the versioned review-and-revert loop.
